sloka: सा बहूनि अमनोज्ञानि वाक्यानि ह्Rदयच्चिदाम् ।अहम् श्रोष्ये सपत्नीनाम् अवराणाम् वरा सती ॥२-२०-३९॥
transliteration: sā bahūni amanojñāni vākyāni hRdayaccidām ।aham śroṣye sapatnīnām avarāṇām varā satī ॥2-20-39॥

translations.english: I, being the eldest (of the queens) will have to listen to many heartbreaking and unpleasant words from my fellowwives who are younger to me.
